sloka: पानीयदूषके पापम् तथैव विषदायके ।यत्तदेकः स लभताम् यस्यार्योऽनुमते गतः ॥२-७५-५५॥
transliteration: pānīyadūṣake pāpam tathaiva viṣadāyake ।yattadekaḥ sa labhatām yasyāryo'numate gataḥ ॥2-75-55॥

translations.english: May the sin of polluting drinking water and administering poison to others be put together and be incurred by the man who counselled the exile of my esteemed brother
